details.name: Airy kurta separates with opacity-tested inners
details.note: Separate inner and loose outer layers for coverage with less bulk. Test opacity, shrinkage and seam stability.

details.name: Adjustable light draped separates
details.note: Trial secure ties and adjustable drape for seated and walking comfort. Keep styling instructions clear.

details.name: Crochet-edged summer shirts
details.note: Small crochet accents on breathable shirts; approve repeatability and wash recovery before scaling.

details.name: Half-lined textured Nehru layers
details.note: Light textured cloth with reduced lining bulk; check collar recovery and perspiration marks.

details.name: Pocketed light occasion skirts
details.note: A lighter wedding-guest skirt with supported pockets and an independently wearable top. Check pocket distortion.

details.name: Secure draped occasion stoles
details.note: Develop unobtrusive original fastening solutions for free movement; stress-test closures and skin contact.

details.name: Controlled metallic-cord accents
details.note: Small placed reflective details, limited to premium trials. Check weight, abrasion, repair and humidity exposure.

details.name: Detachable festive cape panels
details.note: Trial a removable occasion layer with discreet, durable attachment points and clear care instructions.

details.name: Modular travel kurta sets
details.note: Summer 28 hypothesis: compatible separates with useful adjustment. Validate through paid customer pilots in 2027.

details.name: Replaceable ties and spare trim kits
details.note: Summer 28 hypothesis: documented repair components supplied with selected products. Cost the service before promising it.

details.name: Traceable lightweight blend trials
details.note: Summer 28 hypothesis: test light blends with supplier composition and origin records. Certification does not replace performance testing.

details.name: Serviceable occasion-flat components
details.note: Summer 28 hypothesis: explore replaceable parts with footwear suppliers; safety, adhesion and flex tests come before scale.

details.name: Reconfigurable saree occasion layers
details.note: Festive 28 hypothesis: refresh an existing saree with an independent layer. Validate attachment security and fit.

details.name: Removable occasion embellishment panels
details.note: Festive 28 hypothesis: separate fragile ornament for storage and servicing. Test snagging and care economics.

details.name: Reversible light occasion waistcoats
details.note: Festive 28 hypothesis: two useful faces with stable seams and unobtrusive labels. Validate demand before booking cloth.

details.name: Maker-attributed placed craft capsules
details.note: Festive 28 hypothesis: a limited range built with a named craft partner. Confirm origin, labour cost and capacity before claims.
